name: Senir Whitebeard
summary: Outside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, Senir Whitebeard watches Dun Morogh's growing threats. The Senate of Ironforge sent him to assess the Frostmane troll offensive and report their movements to the dwarven leadership.

sections.title: Envoy of the Senate
sections.body: Senir Whitebeard carries the Senate of Ironforge's authority into Kharanos. The city's halls are watching the growing unrest in Dun Morogh, and Senir links the scouts on its snowy frontier with the lawmakers behind Ironforge's stone gates.

sections.title: Eyes on the Frostmanes
sections.body: Senir Whitebeard tracks the Frostmane trolls, whose aggression is growing. Displaced and desperate in the frozen crags, they are pressing close to dwarven settlements and roads. Senir gathers reports on their positions, especially around their stronghold, for Ironforge's military commanders. He gathers intelligence rather than charging into battle.

faq.answer: Senir Whitebeard is an envoy from the Senate of Ironforge, stationed outside Kharanos to gather intelligence on threats in Dun Morogh, especially the Frostmane trolls.

faq.q: What is Senir doing in Kharanos?
faq.answer: Senir Whitebeard is in Kharanos to observe troll activity and coordinate scout reports. Kharanos is a crossroads in Dun Morogh, where he receives field intelligence before sending it to the Senate in Ironforge.

faq.q: Why does the Senate of Ironforge need an envoy here?
faq.answer: The Senate of Ironforge needs Senir Whitebeard to gather firsthand reports from the field. He assesses whether the Frostmane threat calls for an immediate military response from the capital.

faq.q: What is Senir's primary concern in Dun Morogh?
faq.answer: Senir Whitebeard's chief concern is the Frostmane troll incursions. The trolls are pushing out of their camps into dwarf territory and threatening nearby settlements such as Kharanos.

faq.q: Does Senir fight the trolls himself?
faq.answer: No. Senir Whitebeard gathers intelligence and depends on local scouts, Mountaineers, and passing adventurers to enter hostile sites like Frostmane Hold and bring him reports.
Senir Whitebeard sends his reports on troll positions and strengths up the mountain road to the Senate and leadership in Ironforge.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see how Senir Whitebeard links frontier defenders with Ironforge's governing body.
As an Alliance recruit in Dun Morogh, you can help Senir Whitebeard protect Ironforge's heartland from being cut off by troll uprisings.
